g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-301 Ribbon blender 6 cu ft (built in house) · rev B
24 V DC control; safety: PL d / Cat 3 (ISO 13849-1), confirm with the risk assessment
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: E-stop S0 ch1 + cover interlock P1-332 ch1 -> K0 S11/S12
E-stop S0 ch2 + cover interlock ch2 -> K0 S21/S22
RESET S3 (blue) after E-stop or cover open
Safe torque off channel 1: K0 13-14 -> U1 STO1 (motor cannot make torque unless both are on)
Safe torque off channel 2: K0 23-24 -> U1 STO2 (motor cannot make torque unless both are on)
SAFETY OK to plant PLC (X5:4): cover closed and E-stop released
LOCAL: START S1 / STOP S2 with K1 seal-in; REMOTE: run request from the plant PLC (X4:9)
REMOTE run request (dry contact in CP-P1) through S4 REMOTE
VFD FWD (DI1) from K1 (sink, VFD internal 24 V; DCM common)
Motor PTC (X2:TP1/TP2) -> K2 EMT6; K2 trips -> U1 DI3 external fault (motor stops, FAULT lamp)
RUNNING to plant (X5:8) from K1 (+ VFD READY MO1 to X5:5 over the same cable)
High-level switch P1-337 (FTM20, PNP): +24 V on X4:1, signal X4:2 -> X5:3 HIGH; blender also inhibits loading in the PLC
Valve P1-331: plant PLC output (X5:1) energises K331; K331 NO = OPEN, NC = CLOSE (actuator 24 V DC, 2-wire + common)
limits: X6:3 OPEN -> X5:6, X6:4 CLOSED -> X5:7 (wires 173, 174)
1. Stop categories: E-stop and cover open = STO via K0 (stop category 0, IEC 60204-1); STOP button = VFD ramp stop (cat 1 not required, cat 0 by removing FWD is acceptable: coast + 3 s decel).

2. The cover interlock is coded-magnetic, dual channel, monitored by K0 with a manual reset: opening the cover stops the agitator; closing it does NOT restart it (RESET, then START or a new remote request).

3. K0 aux 41-42 in the run rung drops K1 on a safety stop so the seal-in cannot hold through a reset. Remote run is a maintained request from the plant PLC; the PLC must drop it on any safety-OK loss.
4. Validate per P1-301-900 T20..T26 before the first product batch. Keep the PNOZ s4 response time (< 30 ms) and the agitator run-down (< 2 s at 40 rpm) on the validation record.
